method: One independent author per candidate; same inherited model/reasoning, fresh context, generated reference, 25-minute limit, six captures maximum; procedural 3D only; same 1200x900 verified browser software-WebGPU environment; captures serialized. Shared provisioning excluded. Completion includes documentation. Exact token use and monetary billing unavailable. Queue subtraction is NOT measured active work: authors could work while queued. Capture renderAndCleanupMs includes launch, readiness, screenshot and cleanup, NOT pure GPU rendering. Timings are one sample and capture scene complexity changes across iterations. Notes are coordinator anonymizations of author journals/results, not independently instrumented task time.
